name: zabud
source: A small visual novel telling the story of Mark, who had long been deciding to move from his city to another, starting everything from a clean slate. But both old and new acquaintances want to warn him that he won't be able to escape his problems this way, and that he should simply stop worrying about them and live in the present, keep living on. Who knows what will happen: will he stay in his hometown with the people he knows, or will he leave for a new life that might not be so sweet...
